brief: The new infra stack for AI startups in 2026 — bye Heroku, hello Cloudflare.

slots.title: 1. Cloudflare, the edge
slots.body: Kill the monolith. Workers run your inference at the edge, R2 stores models cheaply.

slots.title: 2. Supabase, the database
slots.body: Postgres with auth, realtime, and pgvector built-in. No more juggling RDS and Cognito.

slots.title: 3. Vercel, the frontend
slots.body: Next.js deploys to the edge with one click. AI SDK streams tokens without server setup.

slots.title: 4. Stripe, the billing
slots.body: Metered usage for tokens and API calls. Invoice customers automatically based on inference volume.

slots.title: 5. Anthropic, the brain
slots.body: Claude handles reasoning with a 200K context window. Route complex tasks away from cheap models.

slots.title: 6. Redis, the cache
slots.body: Cache embeddings and rate-limit API keys. Sub-millisecond lookups prevent redundant LLM calls.

slots.headline: Build your AI stack
slots.subline: Swap Heroku for the edge. Save this checklist and start shipping faster tomorrow.
